highlights.title: One Filter button
highlights.detail: One Filter button next to the period replaces the five filter menus and Settings. Search all categories, merchants, items, accounts and countries in one field, or open one list. Tap a row to include it, and tap the ⊘ button to exclude it. Press f to open the panel.

highlights.title: One chip for each filter
highlights.detail: Each filter type shows as one chip under the period, such as Merchant: Kiwi or Rema 1000. Tap a chip to edit that filter, and tap × to remove it.

highlights.title: Settings moved
highlights.detail: Show internal transfers is in the Filter panel. Include deposit is on the Items page.
